description: Pin for the compiler the codegen route lowers through: PyTorchSim-Triton-Backend, with its LLVM, Triton and the vcix-accelerator environment (RISC-V toolchain, pk, Spike, gem5) and the accelerator model. CI builds its base image FROM ghcr.io/psal-postech/pytorchsim-triton-backend:<ref>, the image that repository publishes for every commit on its main and develop, so ref must be such a commit. scripts/build_from_source.sh checks the same ref out for a local toolchain. The repository is private; its package grants this repository read access.
